messages.subject: Meeting Wednesday + Last Tea Time of the Summer!
parts:
Hi D-RUGgies!

We'll be meeting from 10-noon virtually this week (link below). This is a group working session so come with your questions for our expeRts, or just bring your laptop and get in some distraction free R-coding time. 

Also this is the last week of DataLab's Summer Tea Time series! As always we will meet Thursday at 1pm in the Datalab Classroom (Library 360) with cookies and hot beverages. Socializing from 1-2 and co-working from 2-4. It has been a ton of fun and I encourage you all to come out even if this is your first time. We've had a lot of great discussions and serendipitous connections. My hope is that we will continue into the school year but that will depend on scheduling so keep an eye out for future updates!

Zoom at this link: https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/96397082218?pwd=S0JXcW5hcUFkbTcwMHFQV1NVNkg3Zz09

Please consider posting your questions to our Discourse site in advance of attending D-RUG virtually. This helps us do a better job of answering your questions, and also keep a log of the types of questions we see frequently.

See you then,

Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators
